site.title: Agent Tools Catalog: Skills, CLIs & MCP | Code Dimension

faqs.question: What is the difference between a skill, a CLI, and MCP?
faqs.answer: A skill provides reusable instructions for an AI agent. A CLI runs tasks in your terminal. MCP connects an agent to tools and context through a shared protocol. Some tools support more than one of these formats.

faqs.question: How do I find a tool for my objective?
faqs.answer: Search by name, description, category, or creator, then combine Category, Type, and Creator filters. A tool can support multiple objectives and types, but appears only once in the catalog.

faqs.question: How do I install or use a recommended tool?
faqs.answer: Select Visit tool to open its source in a new tab. Follow the source documentation for installation, compatibility, and permissions. Setup differs between skills, CLIs, and MCP tools.

faqs.question: Who creates the tools in this catalog?
faqs.answer: Code Dimension curates this catalog and authors the skills maintained in its repository. Third-party tools retain their own creators, shown on each card and in the Creator filter.

faqs.question: Can AI agents read this catalog without running JavaScript?
faqs.answer: Yes. The catalog is prerendered as static HTML and publishes llms.txt and skills.md with the same tools, categories, types, creators, and source links.
